attachments.origin_landmark: oblique head: bases of metatarsals 2-4; transverse head: deep transverse metatarsal ligament / MTP joint capsules of digits 3-5
attachments.insertion_landmark: proximal phalanx of the great toe (lateral sesamoid, with flexor hallucis brevis's lateral head)

actions: adducts the great toe; the transverse head helps maintain the transverse (metatarsal) arch

functional_compartments.name: Oblique head
functional_compartments.function_note: Larger, more proximally-originating head, running roughly parallel to the metatarsals toward the great toe -- the muscle's primary adductor component.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

functional_compartments.name: Transverse head
functional_compartments.function_note: Smaller, more distal, transversely-oriented head spanning the MTP joints of digits 3-5 -- functionally analogous to the hand's palmar interossei in maintaining transverse alignment, a genuinely distinct fiber-direction compartment within one named muscle.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
